request_response replay responses as live behavior

limitations: source-IP grouping induces statistical dependence within attacker infrastructure
repeated attacks and processing deduplication are source-dataset decisions
no native SSH session independence can be claimed
attack-only corpus cannot identify benign-administration classification or real attacker engagement
no live response behavior is observed in this retrospective input corpus
